caption:
Your dadi's Aam Panna was a probiotic before probiotics were cool. 🥭✨

This summer, skip the sugary sodas. Make THIS instead:

→ 2 tbsp raw mango powder
→ A pinch of PantryPulse black salt
→ 1 tsp roasted cumin powder
→ Jaggery to taste
→ Chilled water + mint

5 minutes. Zero preservatives. Pure desi gut magic.
